Roasted Mushrooms [BOOM 0105]

Prep: 10 minutes · Yield: 13.5 LB · Shelf life: 5 days from cook date

Allergen call out: None of the Top 9 allergens.

Ingredients

  • 20 LB Mushrooms, sliced ¼ inch thick
  • 1 CUP Blended Oil
  • 4 TBSP Kosher Salt
  • 2 TBSP Ground Black Pepper

Method

  1. Mix. Combine mushrooms, oil, salt and pepper in a large Lexan. Mix thoroughly with gloved hands.
  2. Divide. Divide evenly among 4 parchment-lined sheet pans, about 5 LB per pan.
  3. Roast at 595°F. Use a preheated deck pizza oven. Cook 10 minutes. Rotate pans and stir mushrooms if needed; cook another 10 minutes.
  4. Cool. Move trays to the cooling rack in the walk-in. Cool from 139°F to 70°F within 2 hours, then to 41°F or below within 4 more hours. Total: 6 hours maximum.
  5. Package and rotate. Transfer cooled mushrooms to suitable-sized containers. Label, date and rotate.

LEAN Working

Stage a large Lexan and 4 parchment-lined sheet pans. Clear walk-in space before roasting.

Before You Start

Measure oil, salt and pepper. Slice mushrooms ¼ inch thick. Preheat the deck pizza oven to 595°F.
